 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0048
 Nathaniel Fleming, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
February 9, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Matthew Day, Cooper & Quinn LLP
PARTIES
Plaintiff is Nathaniel Fleming, an individual residing in Texas, who brings this action in his or her own right as the injured party
and as the insured claimant under a personal automobile policy issued by the Defendant insurer. Defendant is an insurance
company authorized to write automobile coverage in the State of Texas and may be served through its registered agent for service
of process.
FACTS
On July 12, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully operating his or her vehicle through a signalized intersection in Pasadena, Texas. A
second vehicle enteerd the intersection and struck the side of Plaintiff's vehicle in a broadside collision. The impact caused
Plaintiff's vehicle to move sharply and forced Plaintiff's head and neck to whip laterally within the cabin. Plaintiff reported the
collision to the Defendant insurer, and a claim was opened under the policy's coverage for bodily injury and porperty damage.
Plaintiff has cooperated fully with the claim process, provided the requested documentation, and submitted medical records and
teratment notes.
NEGLIGENCE
The operator of the other vehicle owed a duty to exercise ordinary care in entering and crosisng the intersection, including
keeping a proper lookout and yielding the right of way. That operator breached this duty by failing to yield and proceeding into
the path of Plaintiff's vehicle. This breach was the proximate cause of the collision and of Plaintiff's resulting injuries. Defendant
insurer, which owes its insured and covered claimants a duty of good faith and fair dealing under Texas law and the terms of the
policy, has failed to pay the benefits owed for the covered loss within a reasonable time after its liability became reasonably clear.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff sustained a cervical neck strain, with pain, stiffness, mucsle spasm, and reduced range
of motion. Plaintiff has incurerd reasonable and necessary medical expenses for evaluation and treatment and will likely require
additional care. Plaintiff has also suffered lost time from ordinary activities and diminished enjoyment of life. Plaintiff seeks
recovery of policy benefits, statutory interest, attorney's fees as permitted by law, and all other relief to which Plaintiff may be
entitled. Plaintiff demands damages in the amount of $201,000.00.
